transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I've just been feeling extremely down and depressed lately. It feels like this heavy sadness has been hanging over me for about two months now, and I just can't seem to shake it.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days or longer when you felt unusually energetic or euphoric, needed much less sleep, and were more talkative, impulsive, or active than usual?

No, I've never experienced anything like that. I've never had periods where I felt unusually energetic or didn't need sleep. It has really just been this constant feeling of being down and completely exhausted.
Before these past two months, had you been feeling down or low most days for at least two years, or did this start after a specific stressful life event?
No, I haven't been feeling this way for two years—it really just started about two months ago. I'm also not sure of any specific stressful event that might have triggered it.
During these past two months, have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy?
I'm not really sure if I've lost interest specifically. I just feel so completely exhausted and empty all the time that I don't even have the energy to think about those things.
Over the past two months, have you had changes in your sleep, appetite, concentration, or feelings of worthlessness or guilt?
I haven't really noticed any major changes in my sleep or appetite. I'm also not sure about feelings of worthlessness or guilt, as I haven't really thought about that.
Did these symptoms begin within about three months of a major life stressor, like a breakup, job loss, move, or family conflict?
No, I really can't think of any major life stressor like that. My life has been relatively stable, so I'm not sure if there was a specific event that started all of this.
Have you had any thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?
No, I haven't had any thoughts of hurting myself or ending my life. Even though I've been feeling really down and empty, I've never thought about doing anything like that.
Have other people noticed that you’ve been moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or have you been feeling unusually slowed down or fatigued nearly every day?

Yes, my family has actually noticed that I've been speaking and moving a lot slower lately. My body feels incredibly heavy, and I'm constantly exhausted even from minor activities. It just takes me a lot longer to respond or get anything done.
Over these two months, have you had trouble concentrating, making decisions, or thinking clearly nearly every day?

Yes, I've definitely been struggling with that. Whenever I try to focus, make decisions, or think deeply, I feel completely mentally exhausted and fatigued almost immediately. It's like my brain just runs out of energy right away.
How much have these symptoms been affecting your daily life, like work, school, relationships, or taking care of yourself?

These symptoms have had a major impact on my daily life, making it extremely hard to function. Because of this severe lack of energy and constant physical and mental fatigue, even basic daily activities and routine tasks feel almost impossible to do. I just feel too exhausted to manage my normal day-to-day responsibilities.

Although anhedonia, sleep/appetite change, guilt, and suicidality are not endorsed, the current symptom pattern still keeps Major Depressive Disorder as the sole candidate.
